request.subject: IMPROVEMENT:WINDMILL

layers.text: Change only one thing: the red roofs. The cone roof on top and the small roof over the door become near-black charcoal slate (#2b2b31) with a dark grey edge (#44454d), with no red, no orange and no brown left on them. Do not redraw anything else: the dark stone tower, the four dark ragged sails, the violet windows, the door, the outline and the art style stay exactly the same, on a transparent background.
